snippet.description:
공무원 인사, 정말 공정하게 이루어지고 있을까요?
시장과 간부들이 나누는 은밀한 대화를 통해 공직 사회의 현실을 풍자합니다.

에헤이 천의현 이번에는 공무원 인사에 대한 숏드라마를 준비했습니다.
지금까지 아무도 알려주지 않은 공무원 인사 이야기의 어두운 이면을 다룬 숏드라마 입니다.
일부 지자체에서의 인사위원회는 이미 다 정해진 상태에서 요식행위로 진행되는 경우가 상당한데요 
지난 18년간 기자 생활을 하면서 무조건 있었던 스토리를 드라마로 재현해 봤습니다.
시장이나 군수 즉 인사권자가 절차와 형식을 투명하고 공정한 것처럼 포장해놓고 
결국엔 자기들 하고 싶은데로 하는 이런 밀실 인사.. 위선 아닐까요?

여러분은 공직 사회의 이런 관행에 대해 어떻게 생각하시나요?
실력보다 인맥이 중요한 현실, 이대로 괜찮을까요?

en-US.title: How do closed-door appointments work? [Hallway News ep.1] #PoliticalSatire #ShortDrama #CivilServant
en-US.description:
Is civil service personnel management truly being conducted fairly?

This segment satirizes the reality of the public service through secret conversations shared between mayors and senior officials.

Hey, Cheon Eui-hyeon. This time, I have prepared a short drama about civil service personnel management.

It is a short drama that deals with the dark underbelly of civil service personnel management that no one has ever told you about before.

In some local governments, personnel committees often proceed merely as a formality, with decisions already predetermined.

I have recreated stories that I witnessed without fail during my 18 years as a journalist.

Mayors or county heads—the appointing authorities—package the procedures and formalities as transparent and fair, only to ultimately conduct these closed-door appointments as they please. Isn't this hypocrisy?

What do you think about these practices in the public service?

Is it acceptable to continue with a reality where connections matter more than competence? 00:00 - 🏢 The Mayor's Secret Order, "Prepare the Personnel Committee"

id.description:
Apakah manajemen personel pegawai negeri sipil benar-benar dilakukan secara adil?

Segmen ini menyindir realitas pelayanan publik melalui percakapan rahasia yang dibagikan antara walikota dan pejabat senior.

Hai, Cheon Eui-hyeon. Kali ini, saya telah menyiapkan drama pendek tentang manajemen personel pegawai negeri sipil.

Ini adalah drama pendek yang membahas sisi gelap manajemen personel pegawai negeri sipil yang belum pernah diceritakan kepada Anda sebelumnya.

Di beberapa pemerintahan daerah, komite personel seringkali hanya berjalan sebagai formalitas, dengan keputusan yang sudah ditentukan sebelumnya.

Saya telah menciptakan kembali kisah-kisah yang selalu saya saksikan selama 18 tahun sebagai jurnalis.

Walikota atau kepala kabupaten—pihak yang berwenang mengangkat—mengemas prosedur dan formalitas sebagai sesuatu yang transparan dan adil, hanya untuk akhirnya melakukan pengangkatan tertutup ini sesuka hati mereka. Bukankah ini kemunafikan?
